connector.name: Yandex Wordstat MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Yandex Wordstat API: top & related queries, demand dynamics and regions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-yandex-wordstat. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the askads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WORDSTAT_API_KEY
env.description: Yandex Cloud API key for the Search API (sent as Api-Key). Treat it as a secret.

env.name: WORDSTAT_FOLDER_ID
env.description: Yandex Cloud folder id, injected into every request body.
